title: 18 第18章 震慑19 第19章 力量掌控
content_zh:
在田杰看来，林轩身上的气息并不强横，所以他才敢如此张狂。
那手臂泛着黄蒙蒙的光芒，抓向了林轩。
“哼，穿身黑袍就想装高人？田杰师兄可是凝脉五阶！”
那群少年面带冷笑。
“敢抢我们的东西，简直是找死！”
黄脸摊主也是吓得面无血色，身体蜷缩到一旁，不敢看着血腥的场面。
林轩眉头微皱，他抓住手中的褐色石头，迎上了那黄蒙蒙的拳头。
田杰一看林轩用褐色石头抵挡自己的攻击，心中气闷，但却不敢硬轰，生怕损害道褐色石头。
他中途变拳为爪，扣向林轩的肩头。
林轩依旧快速晃动手臂，用石头来抵挡攻击。
他慢悠悠的说道，我出六十灵石。
“妈的，你不要太猖狂！
耽误了我们的事情，你想死都难了！”
田杰心中郁闷，明明有强大的实力，但却施展不开，这种感觉别提多憋屈了。
“我数三声，你不加价，我就当场捏碎这石头。”
林轩冷笑，“一。”
商业街上那些武者见到有人打起来，以为是宝物出世了，纷纷的围了过来。
“靠，谁这么好的运气，淘到好东西了？”
“哎，好东西也要有命拿啊，竟然遇上了五阶灵士！”
“二！”

林轩喝道，“如果一会引来高手，你可别怪我。”
田杰手掌连续变动，招式精妙无比，但是林轩却始终用褐色石头封堵住他的攻击路线。
“我出七十！”
田杰咬牙切齿的说道，他想好了，只要他得到这石头，第一件事就是撕了这黑袍人。
“什么？七十，我没听错吧！”
周围的人大叫，“一个宝物竟然才卖七十灵石！”
“我出八十，能不能买？”
有人问道。
“价高者得之！”
林轩大笑道。
我出一百！
“妈的，都给我滚！”
田杰大怒，身上灵力涌出，黄色的气流如火焰般跳动。
一些人还想报价，但是却被田杰的气势镇住了。
content_en:
In Tian Jie's opinion, Lin Xuan's aura was not overbearing, that's why he dared to be so arrogant.
The arm glowed with yellow light and grabbed Lin Xuan.
"Hmph, you're wearing a black robe and you want to pretend to be an expert? Senior Brother Tian Jie is at the fifth level of pulse condensation!"
The group of teenagers had sneers on their faces.
"If you dare to steal our things, you are simply seeking death!"
The yellow-faced stall owner was so frightened that his face turned pale and he curled up to one side, not daring to look at the bloody scene.
Lin Xuan frowned slightly. He grabbed the brown stone in his hand and met the yellow fist.
When Tian Jie saw Lin Xuan using the brown stone to resist his attack, he felt depressed, but he did not dare to attack hard for fear of damaging the brown stone.
He turned his fist into a claw midway and clasped Lin Xuan's shoulder.
Lin Xuan still shook his arms quickly and used stones to resist the attack.
He said slowly, I will give you sixty spirit stones.
"Damn it, don't be too arrogant!
If you delay our affairs, it will be difficult for you to die! "
Tian Jie felt depressed. He obviously had great strength, but he couldn't use it. This feeling was extremely frustrating.
"I'll count to three. If you don't increase the price, I will crush the stone on the spot."
Lin Xuan sneered, "One."
When the warriors on the commercial street saw someone fighting, they thought it was a treasure that had been discovered and gathered around them one after another.
"Damn, who is so lucky to find something good?"
"Hey, good things have to be taken with a life, and we unexpectedly met a fifth-level spiritual warrior!"
"Two!"
Lin Xuan shouted, "If you attract a master later, don't blame me."
Tian Jie's palms moved continuously, and his moves were extremely subtle, but Lin Xuan always used brown stones to block his attack route.
"I'll pay seventy!"
Tian Jie gritted his teeth and said that he had thought about it. As long as he got this stone, the first thing he would do was to tear the man in black robes apart.
"What? Seventy, did I hear that right?"
People around shouted, "A treasure is only sold for seventy spirit stones!"
"I'll pay 80, can you buy it?"
someone asked.
“The highest bidder gets it!”
Lin Xuan laughed.
I'll pay a hundred!
"Damn it, get out of here!"
Tian Jie was furious, spiritual power surged out of his body, and the yellow air flow beat like flames.
Some people still wanted to make a quotation, but were suffocated by Tian Jie's momentum.
